articles.description: Mayoral candidates Susana Mendoza and John Kelly both took victory laps after the news of Amtrak’s change in plans surfaced, as if their opposition had anything to do with what happened.
articles.title: Editorial: NIMBYs didn’t kill the South Loop stadium dreams of the White Sox and Justin Ishbia

articles.description: Amtrak said it is dropping its contested plan to move its Chicago maintenance operations to a rail yard in Bridgeport.
articles.title: Amtrak dropping Bridgeport maintenance yard plan, dimming hopes for White Sox stadium at 14th Street

articles.description: Former Chicago White Sox first baseman Paul Konerko and his wife, Jennifer, sold their five-bedroom Lincoln Park home for $3.95 million to an opaque Delaware limited liability company.
articles.title: Former White Sox first baseman Paul Konerko sells Lincoln Park home for nearly $4M

articles.description: The Chicago White Sox came up short in trying to add Dustin May twice in the last year. They finally landed the right-handed starter Wednesday, signing him to a 3-year, $52.5 million deal.
articles.title: Chicago White Sox bank on Dustin May’s untapped upside — and recent durability — to bolster 2027 rotation

articles.description: The Chicago White Sox traded right-handers Davis Martin and Luis Castillo to the Colorado Rockies on Thursday for left-hander Sean Sullivan and minor-league catcher Douglas Veliz.
articles.title: Chicago White Sox trade pitchers Davis Martin and Luis Castillo to Colorado Rockies for pair of prospects

articles.description: Grant Taylor is “super excited” as he moves from the bullpen to the rotation for the Chicago White Sox. “It’s been something I’ve been wanting to do for a while.” ...
articles.title: Pitcher Grant Taylor ‘super excited’ about opportunity to start for the Chicago White Sox

articles.description: The Chicago White Sox and Tyrone Taylor agreed to a two-year deal Tuesday. The outfielder, 32, had a .279/.325/.502 slash line with 11 HRs and 38 RBIs in 2026.
articles.title: Tyrone Taylor agrees to a 2-year, $17M deal with the Chicago White Sox, adding outfield depth

articles.description: Dustin May, 29, went a combined 7-9 with a 4.70 ERA in 31 starts for the St. Louis Cardinals and Milwaukee Brewers in 2026, plus four postseason appearances.
articles.title: Chicago White Sox sign right-hander Dustin May to a 3-year, $52.5 million deal
